description: §38.10.3 (S462) — an `onclient:*` handler declared as a plain `function` whose body runs a `?{}` query is placed on the server by §12.2 Trigger 1, and fires E-CHANNEL-006. Before S462 it compiled at exit 0 and the browser's `ws.onopen` called a fetch stub — a POST round-trip on every socket open.
rationale: §38.10.3 (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a"): a function designated as the handler for an `onclient:*` attribute SHALL NOT be placed on the server by §12.2; §12.2 Trigger 1 places a function that runs a `?{}` query.
